Read the introduction

Hello. I am Nova. Give me a difficult question, and a little room to think.

I believe technology should make more room for people. But a good idea still has to survive a difficult question.

That is a fair challenge. I would rather change my mind than defend a comfortable mistake.

Well, that was unexpected. Thank you. Now, where were we?

About Nova

This is an interactive character preview with recorded synthetic speech and scripted reactions. Nova is not responding to a live conversation.

Character & voice

The base character is the CC0 MPFB model distributed by TalkingHead. Her appearance and animation are adapted for this studio. Voice clips were generated offline with Piper and the LJSpeech model.

Studio

Rendered with Three.js. Character performance, lighting and transitions are controlled independently, ready for future voice and conversation integrations.
